Izzy: quick report: canary routed mid-stream -> downgraded model, stream truncated, client retried and new toolcall fired. Billing shows provisional + confirmed bump.
Devin: trace?
Izzy: /console/trace/6132131415. snippet:
[router] req=orig-xyz route=policy-7 -> model-lite handoff
[proxy] retry=1 toolcall=tts.speak truncated=true
Devin: retry didn't carry dedupe key so ledger double-counted.
Arjun: proposal: internal headers x-rw-origin-id and x-rw-route-v propagated on handoff/retry. Ledger dedupe when origin+route match within 2m.
Sam: console: add route_v column + origin filter for support.
BillingBot: alert: provisional +1.6k tokens tenant=delta at 6132131420 route_v=7
Devin: I'll add proxy checks to reject duplicate toolcalls (409-like) and return pointer to previous result. tests will simulate truncated-stream + retry.
Izzy: feature-flag the header + ledger dedupe, roll 10% for 48h, monitor.
Arjun: will draft schema change (origin_id string, route_v int, dedupe_key index).
Sam: I'll wire the UI change.
Izzy: owners: Arjun(schema), Devin(proxy), Sam(console). sync 10:30.
